title: Absolute environmental claim without complete lifecycle substantiation

source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Absolute claims like '100% natural' or 'zero emission' require proof across the entire lifecycle or clear qualification of scope.

remediation.en: Avoid absolute terms like '100%' or 'zero' unless supported by a published Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) or restricted to a specific qualified component.

tests.input: Certified organic under NPOP (certificate: NPOP/NAB/001) for packaging only
